name: GitHits
description:
GitHits connects Claude to a fast, version-aware index of open-source code, documentation, package intelligence, and implementation examples.

Use GitHits to:

  • Search, navigate, grep, and read exact source files in packages and repositories
  • Search and read package documentation
  • Inspect versions, licenses, dependencies, vulnerabilities, changelogs, and upgrade evidence
  • Find implementation examples and prior art across open-source projects

GitHits helps Claude work from source evidence for the dependency versions in use instead of relying on stale training data or brute-forcing answers with tools not designed for dependency research.

GitHits indexes the open-source ecosystem you app depends on — not your local workspace.

_published_faq.name: How do I add GitHits to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GitHits to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.githits.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GitHits MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GitHits lists 15 MCP tools, including code_files, code_grep, code_read, docs_list, docs_read, feedback, get_example, pkg_changelog, pkg_deps, pkg_info, pkg_upgrade_review, and pkg_vulns.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GitHits?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GitHits in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, and Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator.
GitHits requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
GitHits is developed by GitHits Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
